findings: Original library mapping uses string prefix without component boundary: /photos rule maps /photos2/a.jpg to /mapped2/a.jpg. Mapping first insertion wins, so general /photos hides nested /photos/nested rule. Reproduced original pth.full without filesystem access.

Original greedy pth.base normalization selects last thumbs component: thumbs/user/thumbs/a.jpg becomes /thumbs/a.jpg, dropping user/thumbs segment. Source normalization is lexical, not identity verification.
